title: A C^1 Counterexample to the Entropy Conjecture

abstractEnglish: We disprove the general C1 self-map formulation of Shub's entropy conjecture. We construct a noninvertible C1 self-map of a compact smooth manifold without boundary whose topological entropy is zero, while its action on second real homology has eigenvalue 2. Thus the topological entropy is strictly smaller than the logarithm of the homological spectral radius.
titleEn: A C^1 Counterexample to the Entropy Conjecture

details.overview: 该稿件研究Shub熵猜想在C^1自映射一般形式下的正确性。作者声称构造了一个紧致无边光滑流形上的非可逆C^1自映射，其拓扑熵为零，而在第二实同调上的作用有特征值2。因此拓扑熵严格小于同调谱半径的对数。研究意义在于否定了熵猜想在C^1非可逆情形下的一般表述。
